messages:
maya: Quick check — PR #10234 (feature/x-batch-cache) is ready but CI is flaky. We need a merge window before Thursday's deploy freeze. Can we get a time slot and an approval path? @alex @linh

alex: CI queue is long today, currently 9 pending builds. If tests are only flaky maybe we can merge during tomorrow morning low-traffic window. Who can run a manual smoke? :thinking:

maya: Tests are integration-flaky, I fixed flakiness in latest commit but CI still nags. I'm happy to coordinate manual smoke. Can we reserve 09:30 PT tomorrow? Would avoid conflicting with the freeze.

linh: I can do 09:30 PT, happy to run the smoke and watch the canary. Ping me when you rebase, I'll handle the rollout and rollback hook.

sam: what's the blocker with CI? any failing suites we should care about? :eyes:

maya: Mainly `tests/streaming_cache` that sometimes times out. I added retries and a timeout bump in the last commit.

alex: deploying tomorrow morning SGTM, but need security sign-off on the dependency bump in package.json — @nina can you check?

nina: I can do a quick review now, will post LGTM if no issues. ETA 30m.

deploy-bot: CI queue status: pending=9, running=3. Next free runner estimated in ~48m.

maya: thanks — I'll rebase onto main now and push. Will tag @linh when done.

(10 minutes later)

maya: pushed rebase and retriggered CI: https://ci.internal/12345

alex: re-run flaky job locally? paste logs if it fails.

linh: starting manual smoke at 09:30 PT. If everything passes, merge + canary for 10% traffic. I'll put automatic rollback to 0% if error rate > 2%.

nina: quick note: dependency looks fine, no vulnerable transitive deps. LGTM :thumbsup:

sam: if canary passes feel free to merge, otherwise bring back to thread.

maya: thanks all — tagging final approvals: @nina LGTM, @linh will handle rollout. Setting merge target 09:45 PT tomorrow. I'll update the PR with merge ETA.

linh: noted, will monitor.

deploy-bot: Deploy freeze starts Thu 00:00 UTC. Canary scheduled for 10:00 PT tomorrow unless otherwise noted.

maya: closing loop — will post quick post-merge note in #eng after canary completes.
